note: Pinned base files (tools/steer_sim/PIN_MANIFEST.json) that a branch may change. Every entry needs a reason. Empty at the import: the pins are the bodies as imported. The seven closed_loop / orchard_perception files that the earlier repository listed here (single-row versions imported for the fast SIM) are pinned with exactly those bodies now.

reasons.sim/ubts/closed_loop/estimator.py: PC-05 / PC-06 (design v2 V2-1, V2-3; decisions R31, R33): opt-in actuator prior input (on_actuator, layer L1), corridor quality block and external corridor observation slot. Every option is OFF by default and the default behaviour is bit-identical: test_closed_loop_estimator_exact.py compares the full estimator state with the frozen 999a863 body, and the ten reference episodes (E1-E6, R1-R4) keep their row, trace and executor log hashes (docs/steering/ESTIMATOR_INPUTS_KO.md). Update the PIN_MANIFEST.json entry after the review of this change. S1c (2026-11-13, PREREG_STEER_FOLLOW_V2 iteration 2): opt-in curved row ends (row_end_curve_fit, OFF by default; the front_steer executor turns it on with steer_row_end_curve_fit): the row-end rule measures the cross offset from this update's curved row lines. OFF keeps the 999a863 identity (test_closed_loop_estimator_exact.py, CURVE_FIELDS). S1c round 2 (decision R53): opt-in row-end agreement (row_end_agree_m, None by default; the front_steer executor sets 1.0 m with steer_row_end_agree_m): two consecutive two-sided ended full updates continue the streak only if the reported end moved by at most that distance. OFF keeps the 999a863 identity (AGREE_FIELDS).
reasons.dashboard/scripts/lidar_ws_bridge.py: gsim-final2-20261113 af7a1c3 (SIM_DASHBOARD_KO.md 8): the SIM copy of the LiDAR WebSocket bridge answers profile=mapping with the original LaserScan (raw_scan: header, every range, the angle and range fields), as the dashboard repository's own bridge does, so the dashboard's live map (dashboard_server/source_live_mapping.py) can use SIM scans. Only the mapping profile changes: its points list is empty and it is sent at max_hz without the bandwidth delay; every other profile sends the same message as the pinned body (test_steering_sim_lidar_mapping.py checks that the preview message has no raw_scan). The vehicle bridge of the dashboard repository is not touched. A wrapper module was not used: the change is inside the request handler and the ScanState of this file, and a monkeypatching wrapper would replace both bodies anyway. Update the PIN_MANIFEST.json entry after the review.

Drop the PIN_MANIFEST.json entry together with this allowlist line after the review.
